text_block_list.text:
And so, Mayano Top Gun's debut race came 
to a successful close, but—

Mayano Top Gun has been acting strangely 
for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What do I mean by that? Just that 
it's over now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-chan! Is my debut race 
really all over after this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're not still secretly hiding some, are 
you?!

...Even if you say that, a debut race is 
something everyone can only experience 
once.

...However, Mayano Top Gun doesn't look 
satisfied in the slightest.
choice_data_list: Want to try entering more races?
Shall we try entering more races?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because I finally managed to debut. I 
finally made it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...It's supposed to be a place full of 
excitement and sparkle, after all.
